document.adaptation: The first sentence of the quote dropped (“At some point we're going to have to draw a line in the sand and say this is the best way to manage the dam and manage resources in the Grand Canyon.”).
document.text: Meanwhile, others are simply unhappy with the arguing and indecision that have plagued the issue. Martha Hahn, science center director at the national park, said, "We can't continue to go on and on just researching. We have to make a decision. We really are losing valuable resources."
